# Authoring .work files

<!-- GENERATED by `work weave` from skills/authoring_work_files.work — do not edit; edit the source docs it composes. -->

The `.work` file is the unit of a workbook: a **literate document** where prose
narrates and `do … end` blocks run. There is **no HTML, no code fences, no markdown
authoring** — the first word of a block names its kind (`data`, `def`, `server`,
`client`, `flow`, `sandbox`, `agent`, `record`, `resource`, …) and the block is
self-delimiting. This skill is the reference for writing correct `.work`.

When the user is writing or editing block syntax, declarations, placement, or refs,
load the matching reference below.
